# FAZ.NET

> > FAZ.NET is the digital platform of Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung (F.A.Z.), offering news content, interactive games, and comprehensive archive services.

The site serves as the online presence of one of Germany's leading newspapers, providing access to editorial content, puzzles and brain teasers, and professional research tools including the F.A.Z.-Archiv with licensing and media monitoring capabilities.

## Archive & Research Services

- [F.A.Z.-Archiv](https://fazarchiv.faz.net/): Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung archive with search and licensing services

## Optional
